thread:
alyssa (Partnerships): vendor just pushed ETA for Rack SKU RDX-RACK-42 from 2026-04-12 -> 2026-05-03. affects EU dedicated commits.
Mike (Logistics): confirmed? link to vendor note: https://vendor.example.com/notes/1823 
alyssa (Partnerships): yes, vendor rep: 'component shortage on midplane, firm ETA 2026-05-03'. they said manifest will ship 5/1.
jordan (SIs): our EU pilot needs >=6 racks by 2026-04-20. can we swap with US pool?
Mike (Logistics): we have 2 spare in US staging. cross-border add ~10-14 days for customs.
eric (PM): option: temp move customers to cloud marketplace capacity and credit them. cheaper than shuffling racks?
alyssa (Partnerships): marketplace partner offered temporary reservation swap but price ~1.4x. they're open to crediting customer for delta.
Jordan (SIs): avoid hitting customers with extra cost. propose 30% marketplace credit + clear delay notice.
Mike (Logistics): note: moving US racks to EU will reduce US throughput ~40% for the swap window. we need runbooks for rollback.
ops-bot: [automated] Reservation imbalance detected: region-us -> region-eu planned transfer of 2 units; please confirm.
alyssa (Partnerships): proposed plan:
1) offer customer 30% marketplace credit + free extended support for 30 days
2) urgent crossdock of 1 US rack to EU as priority (expedite freight)
3) enable marketplace capacity autoscale for burst traffic
eric (PM): can finance run cost delta and SLA impact? cc @FinanceSam
FinanceSam: will calc delta. need model id + avg tokens/hr/day.
alyssa (Partnerships): model rdx-7b-quant, avg ~1.2M tokens/day.
Mike (Logistics): expedited freight quote $9k/rack (5-7d transit + customs). standard $3k/rack (14-21d). customs lead times are variable.
jordan (SIs): customer ok to wait until 5/3 if we get 30% credit; they'd rather not accept a cross-region move.
alyssa (Partnerships): customer also requested coordination on joint announcement for Dedicated GA — they'll want a firm ship date before go-ahead.
eric (PM): recommend postponing joint announcement until capacity is locked. action: @design hold assets, @comms draft a delay note.
Emily (design): ack — holding assets.
CommsBot: @comms auto-created draft: 'Dedicated GA delivery update' — https://notion.example/notices/rdx-dedicated-delay 
Mike (Logistics): if we decide to swap, customs paperwork needs to start today. i'll prep docs when we confirm.
jordan (SIs): if marketplace swap happens, SI needs to validate config parity. any config diffs? rack spec: RDX-RACK-42 => 8xA800, 2x100G NIC.
alyssa (Partnerships): confirmed spec matches marketplace units.
ops-bot: [action] assigned: @Mike (Logistics) create crossdock manifest #CRS-786 by 2460012400.
Mike (Logistics): manifest CRS-786 created, pushed to drive: https://drive.example.com/drive/folders/0A1BCRS-786 
alyssa (Partnerships): I'll confirm vendor rep again & lock marketplace swap if finance + PM sign off. will update customer post-EOD.
Mike (Logistics): :thumbsup:
